sentences.text:
Prosecution case, in brief, is that in the intervening night of 6 - 7.06.2023 at about 01:00 hours,
applicant aged about 42 years knowing the fact that the prosecutrix aged about 83 years belongs to SC/ST community entered into her house and forcefully committed sexual intercourse with her.
sentences._hearing_file: Shahid Ali vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 July, 2023.json

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellant submits that about a month prior to the incident on 10.05.2023 during marriage ceremony of applicant's daughter, prosecutrix's son was making nuisance in intoxicated condition and the quarrel took place between the applicant and prosecutrix's son, due to which, after about a month on 06-07.06.2023, this false and fabricated case was made on the instance of the prosecutrix.
sentences._hearing_file: Shahid Ali vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 July, 2023.json

sentences.text: The prosecutrix's story appears unnatural and prosecutrix's age is 85 years, while applicant is aged about 42 years.
sentences._hearing_file: Shahid Ali vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 July, 2023.json

sentences.text: It is highly improbable that such a lady was subjected to sexual assault.
sentences._hearing_file: Shahid Ali vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 July, 2023.json

sentences.text: The applicant is in custody since 08.06.2023 and his custodial interrogation is no more required.
sentences._hearing_file: Shahid Ali vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 July, 2023.json

sentences.text: Trial will take time to conclude.
sentences._hearing_file: Shahid Ali vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 July, 2023.json

sentences.text: Under these circumstances, the applicant may be enlarged on bail.
sentences._hearing_file: Shahid Ali vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 July, 2023.json

sentences.text: Learned Public Prosecutor for the State has opposed the prayer and submits that the prosecutrix in her statement recorded during investigation specifically alleged against the applicant.
sentences._hearing_file: Shahid Ali vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 July, 2023.json

sentences.text: Offences alleged against the applicant are serious in nature, therefore, he is not entitled for bail.
sentences._hearing_file: Shahid Ali vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 July, 2023.json

sentences.text: Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
sentences._hearing_file: Shahid Ali vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 July, 2023.json

sentences.text: Having considered the rival submissions, material pointed out by the learned counsel for the appellant, age of the prosecutrix, MLC reports and the statements recorded during investigation, so also the applicant's age and other material produced on record, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, this Court is of the view that appellant deserves to be enlarged on bail.
sentences._hearing_file: Shahid Ali vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 July, 2023.json

sentences.text:
Hence,
this appeal is allowed and the order passed by the Special Court is hereby set aside.
sentences._hearing_file: Shahid Ali vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 July, 2023.json

sentences.text:
It is directed that the appellant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Trial Court with a direction that he will cooperate in trial and present himself regularly before the Trial Court on each and every date fixed by the Court concerned during trial and if during trial, he is found absent without any sufficient cause by the Trial Court, then the bail order passed by this Court shall automatically come to an end without reference to the Court.
With the aforesaid, this appeal stands allowed and disposed of.
sentences._hearing_file: Shahid Ali vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 July, 2023.json
